sentences.text: The Crime and Corruption Commission audited council controls for employee conflicts of interest and responses to related allegations.
sentences.support: an audit examining how allegations involving conflicts of interest by council employees are dealt with by councils

sentences.text: The CCC found that 10 of the 13 councils needed a coordinated framework for identifying, managing and monitoring conflicts.
sentences.support: Of the 13 councils selected to participate in the audit, we recommended 10

sentences.text: It concluded that complaints were generally handled satisfactorily, while identifying scope to improve complaints procedures and outcomes.
sentences.support: there is a need for councils to put into place a specific procedure for corrupt conduct complaints

sentences.text: The CCC recommended conflict management frameworks, procedures for gifts and benefits, and regular audits of conflict management.
sentences.support: The audit identified that nine of the councils need to develop a procedure, and associated tools, for managing gifts and benefits

findings.quote: The CCC audit showed considerable variation in the adequacy of procedures for handling corrupt conduct complaints across the councils.
Overall, complaints were dealt with satisfactorily.

notes: The pack is the October 2017 employee conflicts audit. It does not give one numbered total for all recommendations.
